notes: The beach passes (docs/COAST.md §9.5): valleys cut through retail's end-of-map mountain ring so every beach is reachable on foot from Jangan. pnpm tsx packages/convert/src/tools/beach-passes.ts [--export <dir>] writes them into content/world-edits/jangan-fields/ (height deltas merged with the layers already there, walk force-open on the pass floor).

A pass: a polyline in glTF metres (x east, z south), the floor's half width, the steepest grade along it (the floor is the largest grade-limited profile under the ground: it only cuts, never fills), and the valley walls' slope out to where they meet the ground.
